ItemID: NA; Title: Elvis 30 #1 Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Familiar older hits fit my recent interest in classic singles and retrospective collections.
ItemID: NA; Title: Earth Wind & Fire Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in revisiting folk and classic rock than a funk-focused collection right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection matches my taste.
ItemID: NA; Title: Simply Red - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Their smooth pop sound is less appealing to me today than the older rock and folk I have been revisiting.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Christmas Songs; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My latest Christmas album makes this relevant, but I would want to know the performers before choosing another collection.
ItemID: NA; Title: Very Best Of; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title does not identify the artist or songs, so I would pass.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20th Century Masters: The Millennium Collection - The Best of Lesley Gore; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Her 1960s pop fits my interest in AM Gold and nostalgic hit collections particularly well.
ItemID: NA; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Their melodic rock and harmonies suit my interest in Simon & Garfunkel and classic rock compilations.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Cher; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A career-spanning pop collection appeals to me, but I would choose Lesley Gore and Eagles first this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of Fleetwood Mac; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Their melodic classic rock feels like a good continuation of The Cars and Now Classic Rock Hits.
